# Skybridge Property Group

> > Full-service property management company serving Southern California landlords and tenants across Los Angeles, Diamond Bar, Long Beach, and surrounding communities since 2010.

Skybridge Property Group, led by Faraaz Hashmi, provides comprehensive property management services including tenant screening, rent collection, lease agreements, vacancy management, and professional property marketing. Licensed by the California Bureau of Real Estate (BRE), they specialize in residential rental properties throughout Greater Los Angeles and the Inland Empire.

- Property Management
- Southern California Rental Market
- Lease Agreements & Tenant Screening

- Professional Photography & Videography
- Huntington Beach, Long Beach, Riverside Markets
